description: Minnesnowii is authentic Hawaiian style Shave Ice in Minnesota. Experience the finest flavors and texture that only our shave ice can offer!

brand.headline: Minnesota's Premier Shave Ice Company

about.title: About Minnesnowii
body: In forming our company, we combined our love for Hawaii and Minnesota, creating Minnesnowii Shave Ice. Our pride is serving Authentic Hawaiian Style Shave Ice, just like in paradise.
The flavors we offer are imported from Hawaii and we use the best commercial block shavers to finely shave the ice. It is so soft that there is never a crunch from the first bite till the last.

contactCta.body: Tell us about your party, festival, or corporate event and we will help you plan the moment guests remember.
